recognize_zh: 淋巴結 H&E：大片形態一致的小至中型細胞，核圓形、染色質細緻、有小核仁，每顆細胞周圍有淡粉紅細胞質使核彼此平均間隔，間有纖細血管，是邊緣區（monocytoid）B 細胞的生長型態。
features: Diffuse monotonous sheet of small to intermediate lymphoid cells
Round, regular nuclei with fine chromatin and small nucleoli
Moderate pale eosinophilic cytoplasm producing even nuclear spacing
Few larger cells; low mitotic activity in this field
Delicate thin-walled vessels traversing the infiltrate
describe_en: H&E section of lymph node shows a diffuse, monotonous infiltrate of small to intermediate lymphoid cells with round, regular nuclei, fine chromatin and small nucleoli. Moderate pale cytoplasm results in evenly spaced nuclei, and delicate vessels traverse the infiltrate. Mitotic figures and large transformed cells are infrequent in this field. The appearance is compatible with marginal zone lymphoma with monocytoid features, though immunohistochemistry is required to separate it from other small B-cell lymphomas.

ddx.vs: Mantle cell lymphoma is also monotonous but has scant cytoplasm, irregular nuclei, pink hyalinized vessels and cyclin D1 positivity.
Lymphoblasts have finer dusty chromatin, higher N:C ratio, frequent mitoses and TdT positivity.
Hairy cells have abundant clear cytoplasm with 'fried-egg' spacing and express CD103, CD123, annexin A1 and BRAF V600E.
